name: claude-maestro
description: Turns one Claude Code chat into an orchestrator for loop engineering: roadmap, spec, review gate, implement, verify, run by Sonnet-capped subagents with on-disk state and a PreToolUse guard hook. The unattended loop runs in the local control panel (harness serve) from the same repository: graph view of the roadmap, approve, answer, instruct, deliver, on your own Claude subscription through the claude CLI, with no API token.
